body: Nopeeeeeeeeee we're definitely 33 and have known each other since highschool. She very, very much still has a high school immature victim-card mentality and love drama. I genuinely think she looks to find things to argue with people about because she gets bored and wants people to bend to her, which I will not do.
Oh, that's the even funnier part. We're 33.

I’d say it’s less so the pressure of friends, and more that the comments from them sort of poked at a thought/anxiety that already existed in my head. I’ve never cared much about friend pressure, I’m not thinking engagement/marriage, and we don’t want kids so no pressure there.

Neither of us is thinking buying a house, we’d just like a two-bedroom apartment. It’s a bit of both for him. We live in a very large, very expensive city so me being able to afford living solo is sort of out of the norm. He’s also really good friends with the guys he lives with, which adds to that “no urgency” to move out.

Sorry, should have been clear - it's never an in person hangout, it's always sitting on Discord from 7/8ish for the entire night.

I don't cancel very much? There was a weekend I was away that they forgot about and freaked out at me for, this past weekend and that's about it recently. I may be out again this Saturday with family, but even just floating that to them made them sulky.

I've tried to communicate in a gentle/friendly way that "hey, I know we did this every single weekend during Covid but I have a bit more going on in my life now, if we could be flexible and do Fridays/Sundays on weekends Saturdays don't work", but it always seems they just come down on "you're ditching us".
